sn35.114:1.1: Santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn35.114:1.2: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.114:1.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu āvāsagato Mārassa Mārassa vasaṃgato || || Paṭimukkassa Mārapāso
sn35.114:1.4: baddho so Mārabandhanena yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato || pa ||
sn35.114:3.1: Santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīya || ||
sn35.114:3.2: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati
sn35.114:3.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu āvāsagato Mārassa Mārassa vasaṃgato || || Paṭimukkassa Mārapāso
sn35.114:4.1: Santi ca kho bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn35.114:4.2: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.114:4.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu na āvāsagato Mārassa na Mārassa vasaṃgato || || Ummukkassa Mārapāso
sn35.114:4.4: mutto so Mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato || la ||
